title: Research Group Officially Named G.O.A.T LAB
summary: Our research group has been officially named the Genesis of Operando Atomic Thought (G.O.A.T) LAB, reflecting our core scientific vision.
content:
On January 24, 2026, we are excited to announce that our research group has officially adopted the name Genesis of Operando Atomic Thought (G.O.A.T) LAB.

This name embodies our dedication to exploring the fundamental origins of material behaviors and device performances at the atomic scale. We look forward to pushing the boundaries of electron microscopy under this new banner.

title: Group New Year Dinner at Jiangnan Joy City
summary: To enhance team cohesion, all members of the group went to Jiangnan Joy City for a delightful New Year dinner.
content:
On January 23, 2026, Prof. Zhang led the entire research group to Jiangnan Joy City in Wuxi for a relaxing and joyful dinner at 'Qian Xiao Nu' Buffet.

Everyone enjoyed the delicious food while sharing their life experiences and future goals, fostering a strong sense of community within the lab.

title: Prof. Zhang's Group Established and Welcomes First Members
summary: The research group was officially established, warmly welcoming the first batch of 6 graduate students (2 Ph.D. and 4 Master's students).
content:
September 16, 2025 marks a memorable milestone—Prof. Qiubo Zhang's Research Group was officially established!

We are extremely honored to welcome our founding members:

🎓 Ph.D. Students: Yu Su, Ziming Shang (Direct Ph.D.)
🎓 Master's Students: Keyu Wang, Yi Tang, Shuai Zhang, Xingyu Xu

The addition of these highly motivated students injects boundless energy into the lab. We look forward to achieving great success together at the SEU Wuxi Campus!
